name: Question 8
problem:
Find a matrix that defines the orthogonal projection of ${R}^{3}$ onto the plane whose parametric equation is $r=sv+tw$, where

$$
v=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,w=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 2\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
Recall that the matrix ${P}_{S}=A({A}^{T}\,A)^{-1}\,{A}^{T}$ maps any vector $x\in {R}^{n}$ onto its orthogonal projection in the subspace $S$ spanned by the columns of the matrix $A.$ 

Notice that the plane $r=sv+tw$ is actually the subspace $\text{Span}{v,w}.$ 
Hence, we have 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \\ 2 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{P}_{S} & =A({A}^{T}\,A)^{-1}\,{A}^{T} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \\ 2 & 2\end{aligned}]{([\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \\ 2 & 2\end{aligned}])}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \\ 2 & 2\end{aligned}]{[\begin{aligned}5 & 4 \\ 4 & 5\end{aligned}]}^{-1}[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{9}[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \\ 2 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}5 & -4 \\ -4 & 5\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{9}[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \\ 2 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-5 & -4 & 2 \\ 4 & 5 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{9}[\begin{aligned}5 & 4 & -2 \\ 4 & 5 & 2 \\ -2 & 2 & 8\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Find a matrix that defines the orthogonal projection of R3 onto the plane whose parametric equation is r=sv+tw, where v=[−102],w=[012].

a
19[54−2452−228]
b
13[54−1451−114]
c
13[24−2422−224]
d
19[24−2422−224]
e
116[54−1451−114]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Recall that the matrix PS=A(ATA)−1AT maps any vector x∈Rn onto its orthogonal projection in the subspace S spanned by the columns of the matrix A.

Notice that the plane r=sv+tw is actually the subspace Span{v,w}. Hence, we have A=[−100122]. Therefore, PS=A(ATA)−1AT=[−100122]([−102012][−100122])−1[−102012]=[−100122][5445]−1[−102012]=19[−100122][5−4−45][−102012]=19[−100122][−5−42452]=19[54−2452−228].
